legacy_migration.trigger: LOCKED-SCRIPT-GATED: a project-original real-time route crosses three or more visually distinct zones and the audience must retain where the moving group has been and where it is heading
legacy_migration.directing_decision: HYPOTHESIS: register each new zone with one readable project-original landmark and an exit/destination vector before tightening into body action; return to a route anchor whenever orientation is at risk
legacy_migration.coverage: Origin-zone relation wide → first threshold → zone action/relation → exit vector → next-zone anchor/action; repeat only for script-required zones → terminal destination relation
legacy_migration.blocking: Assign stable zone IDs, threshold sides and project-original waypoint landmarks; move principal visual tracks through an explicit entry/exit vector and keep crowd bodies from obscuring every anchor simultaneously
legacy_migration.pacing_edit: Let physical distance and each script-verified state change determine hold length; do not copy the source's 354.500s duration or treat continuous motion as automatic urgency
legacy_migration.sound: SND-UNK: audio was not auditioned; dialogue, commands, impacts, sirens, footsteps, ambience, score and sound-led route timing remain UNKNOWN
legacy_migration.applicability: Escort, evacuation, search, pursuit, covert transit or group movement where locked-script geography and a shared clock are necessary to comprehension
legacy_migration.non_applicability: Deliberate disorientation is the goal; time ellipsis is required; only one room matters; a stationary master communicates every state; or safe production/generation cannot preserve the route
legacy_migration.failure_mode: Motion continues without readable waypoints; doors or screen direction flip; bodies teleport between zones; landmarks become decorative rather than orienting; or source-specific buildings/events are copied
legacy_migration.counterexample: COUNTEREXAMPLE UNKNOWN: same-trigger contrary evidence pending. Different-trigger boundary: CHILDREN-CAND-CABIN-ZONES-AS-MOBILE-GEOGRAPHY-001 uses seats and apertures inside one moving enclosure rather than a multi-building route
legacy_migration.unknown: Exact source geography, intended route, identities, roles, reason for movement, chronology beyond adjacent frames, hidden stitches, rig, sound and audience effect

legacy_migration.fallback: Project-original fallback: six short units maximum—origin master, threshold A, zone B relation, threshold B, terminal-zone relation and destination close; camera uses fixed marks, performance caps at two principal bodies per unit, continuity locks zone/door/person IDs and entry/exit vectors

legacy_migration.blocking: Lock hinge/threshold side, entering and exiting person tracks, project-original held-object state, body level and next travel vector; never infer custody or same-person identity from a disconnected insert

legacy_migration.failure_mode: A person or object changes sides without path; doors reset open/closed; a close insert falsely proves ownership; crossing and after-state disagree; every doorway receives equal weight
